reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the concept of dynamic precipitation from single-phase FCC HEAs (P1, P10) with the role of interphase boundaries in dual-phase alloys (P39, P42) and the beneficial effect of serrated boundaries (P18, P20, P24, P26) into a new proposal: in situ, stress-activated formation of nano-precipitates specifically along coherent FCC/BCC interphase boundaries. No passage proposes or studies this combined mechanism for a dual-phase FCC/BCC coating; the idea links evidence from separate alloy systems and mechanisms into a single, non-obvious prediction.
